What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking never updates, this can happen while the courier processes or scans the package. It may take a few days after shipment for the first scan to appear. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first tracking update.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s website.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the delay.
If the tracking remains stalled for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot provide information, you can email care@nurosym.com with your tracking number so the shipping issue can be reviewed.
